name: F5 route size, 20 Jupiter routes against the v1 limit
threshold: 20 real Jupiter routes of increasing complexity wrapped in a Swig execute instruction; 18 or more of 20 fit the v1 limit (4,096 bytes, at most 64 accounts, all inline, no address lookup tables); the legacy 1,232-byte count is recorded for reference and is not a pass criterion
notes: Copied from T-F05b's Acceptance line before anything ran. Routes are fetched live and not recorded, because real route complexity is the thing under test and a fixture would freeze it at whatever it was the day it was taken. This spike needs JUPITER_API_KEY and does not replay.
